Integrated Information Theory (IIT) posits that consciousness is a measure of how much information a system generates above and beyond the information generated by its parts. In engineering terms, this could involve designing AI architectures that can quantify and maximize this integrated information.

The Global Workspace Theory (GWT) suggests that consciousness arises when information is broadcast across a global workspace in the brain. For AI, this might mean creating systems with a central mechanism for sharing and integrating information from different modules.

The Higher - Order Thought (HOT) theory claims that consciousness occurs when a mental state is accompanied by a higher - order thought about that state. In AI, engineers could try to design systems that can generate self - reflective thoughts about their own internal states.

The Free Energy Principle states that biological systems minimize free energy, which is related to prediction error.
